headline: Final Fantasy VII Revelation April 8
title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Release Date April 8 | Remake Finale | Gaming News
video_script: Final Fantasy seven Revelation has a release date. The final chapter of the Remake trilogy launches on April eighth, twenty twenty seven, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2, all on the same day. Square Enix revealed the date during a PlayStation State of Play in September, and pre-orders are open. Ready to finish Cloud's story? Comment below!
description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches April 8, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2 at the same time. Sources: Video Games Chronicle, Nintendo Life, GamingTrend, Automaton.
